bugs.title: Series Part 2+ re-runs full Stage A instead of reusing Part 1's evidence
bugs.notes: Seeded from sweep brief. Suspected causes: (1) stage-a-request.json for a 'start next part' action carries the ORIGINAL full source spec instead of a series-continuation request; (2) stage-a.yml reuse step gates on steps.req.outputs.series_source_job_id but the request JSON nests it as series.source_job_id — the id:req parsing step may never populate that output. Reuse step logic itself appears complete/correct.

bugs.title: Zernio 'Publish' button still shown on a task already published automatically
bugs.notes: Seeded from sweep brief. Investigate: (1) whether task view checks publishing.status before showing the Publish button; (2) whether the automatic-publish workflow writes back publishing status to status.json. Fix so a published task hides the manual Publish button or replaces it with a 'View publish status' affordance.
